slices.title: Typed RUN_ATTENTION events from outbox
slices.summary: Adds a session-core sweeper that writes one content-free RUN_ATTENTION outbox row per pending waiting item, with opaque ids only and no row for ZDR runs, published on the existing run-event subject with no ACL, CHECK or provisioner change.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p session-core --bin session-core attention -- --ignored --test-threads=1

slices.title: Member quota readout
slices.summary: Adds a member-visible allowance line: a billing.quota.read action contract registered beside billing.allowances.read, a typed client over the existing BFF route GET /api/v1/billing/quotas/{metric} that parses QuotaStatus (limit, used, remaining, is_exceeded, utilization), and a secondary RunCostMeter line that warns at utilization 0.8 or when exceeded, labelled as organisation-wide. No model-gateway change; per-user allowance is out of scope.
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm vitest run src/shared/api/billing-quota.test.ts src/features/chat/components/RunCostMeter.test.tsx
slices.flag: VITE_QUOTA_READOUT (name not fixed by the plan; default off)

slices.title: Do runs retrieve from the project
slices.summary: Do runs in a project forward a Space retrieval authorization from model-gateway to execution-core so knowledge_search runs Space-scoped. A Space-scoped run without a token gets a typed 'project knowledge unavailable' tool error, never an unscoped search. Behind AGENTIC_SPACE_RETRIEVAL_ENABLED (default off, where off is today's unscoped Do search).
slices.flag: AGENTIC_SPACE_RETRIEVAL_ENABLED (gateway env, default off; off = today's unscoped Do search); enablement gated by the WS18-D8 decision-TTL measurement
